entries.title: Continuous integration
entries.key_innovation: Proposes using GitHub to empirically assess whether software process integration and automation innovations improve project performance.

entries.title: Quality and productivity outcomes relating to continuous integration in github
entries.key_innovation: Empirically investigates the relationship between continuous integration adoption in GitHub projects and software quality and productivity outcomes.

entries.title: The impact of continuous integration on other software development practices
entries.key_innovation: Mixed-methods analysis of how Travis CI adoption reshapes coding, issue/pull request closing, and testing practices in GitHub projects.

entries.title: Lessons from eight years of operational data from a continuous integration service
entries.key_innovation: Analyzes 22.2 million CircleCI builds across 7,795 projects over eight years to identify improvement opportunities for CI service providers.

entries.title: Towards languageindependent brown build detection
entries.key_innovation: Proposes a language-independent approach for detecting brown builds in continuous integration.

entries.title: An empirical analysis of flaky tests
entries.key_innovation: Presents the first extensive empirical study of flaky tests, classifying root causes and common developer fix strategies.

entries.title: Understanding flaky tests
entries.key_innovation: Examines developer perceptions of the nature, relevance, and challenges of flaky tests.

entries.title: A study on the lifecycle of flaky tests
entries.key_innovation: Characterizes the lifecycle of flaky tests, including recurrence, runtime, and time-before-fix across proprietary and open-source projects.

entries.title: Empirical study of restarted and flaky builds on travis ci
entries.key_innovation: Uses outcome differences between original and restarted Travis CI builds to reveal build flakiness.

entries.title: Repeated builds during code review
entries.key_innovation: Studies repeated builds triggered by Gerrit recheck during code review to understand repeated build use and resource waste.

entries.title: Continuous test suite failure prediction
entries.key_innovation: Predicts whether a code change should trigger the test suite using machine learning features from the change, test suite, and history.

entries.title: On the prediction of continuous integration build failures using search-based software engineering
entries.key_innovation: Uses multi-objective genetic programming to predict CI build failures while addressing imbalanced build result distributions.

entries.title: Characterizing timeout builds in continuous integration
entries.key_innovation: Characterizes prevalence and contributing factors of CI timeout builds to improve CI service stability and resource management.

entries.title: An empirical study of the impact of modern code review practices on software quality
entries.key_innovation: (title-only) An empirical study of the impact of modern code review practices on software quality

entries.title: The impact of data normalization on the´ accuracy of machine learning algorithms
entries.key_innovation: (title-only) The impact of data normalization on the´ accuracy of machine learning algorithms

entries.title: Are fix-inducing changes a moving target? a longitudinal case study of just-in-time defect prediction
entries.key_innovation: (title-only) Are fix-inducing changes a moving target? a longitudinal case study of just-in-time defect prediction

entries.title: The proof and measurement of association between two things
entries.key_innovation: (title-only) The proof and measurement of association between two things

entries.title: An empirical study of the long duration of continuous integration builds
entries.key_innovation: (title-only) An empirical study of the long duration of continuous integration builds

entries.title: An exploratory study of the pull-based software development model
entries.key_innovation: Empirically characterizes pull-based software development, identifying factors influencing pull request merge decisions and processing time.

entries.title: A first look at good first issues on github
entries.key_innovation: Studies GitHub's good first issue label, analyzing its application status, effects, problems, and best practices for newcomer onboarding.

entries.title: The meaning and use of the area under a receiver operating characteristic (roc) curve
entries.key_innovation: Shows AUC represents the probability that a randomly chosen diseased subject is ranked above a non-diseased subject and equals the Wilcoxon statistic, yielding variance and sample size formulas.

entries.title: Regression modelling strategies for improved prognostic prediction
entries.key_innovation: Compares step-up variable selection, incomplete principal components regression, and Cox regression after data reduction using predictive discrimination to improve prognostic models.

entries.title: Regression models for prognostic prediction
entries.key_innovation: Introduces regression modelling strategies for prognostic prediction.

entries.title: The precision-recall plot is more informative than the roc plot when evaluating binary classifiers on imbalanced datasets
entries.key_innovation: Argues precision-recall plots are more informative than ROC plots for evaluating binary classifiers on imbalanced datasets.

entries.title: How biased is the apparent error rate of a prediction rule?
entries.key_innovation: Provides simple estimates of apparent error rate downward bias for exponential family linear models, linking cross-validation, bootstrap, and AIC.

entries.title: An empirical comparison of model validation techniques for defect prediction models
entries.key_innovation: Empirically compares model validation techniques for defect prediction, revealing high instability and quantifying bias and variance.

entries.title: An empirical analysis of fault persistence through software releases
entries.key_innovation: Shows high fault counts at a file's first release are an early and significant indicator of continued fault-proneness across later releases.

entries.title: The impact of automated parameter optimization on defect prediction models
entries.key_innovation: Shows automated parameter optimization improves defect prediction AUC by up to 40 points and shifts variable importance rankings.

entries.title: Resource usage and optimization opportunities in workflows of github actions
entries.key_innovation: Presents first comprehensive empirical study of GitHub Actions workflow resource usage and optimization opportunities, identifying cost drivers like testing and building.

entries.title: A cost-efficient approach to building in continuous integration
entries.key_innovation: Proposes a cost-efficient approach to building in continuous integration, likely reducing build costs through selective execution.

entries.title: Which builds are really safe to skip? maximizing failure observation for build selection in continuous integration
entries.key_innovation: Develops CI-Run rules to complement CI-Skip rules, aiming to save CI computational cost while maximizing observation of failing builds.

entries.title: Does socio-technical congruence have an effect on software build success? a study of coordination in a software project
entries.key_innovation: Studies whether socio-technical congruence affects build success, finding the relationship depends on build type and sometimes higher congruence lowers success.

entries.title: Improving the prediction of continuous integration build failures using deep learning
entries.key_innovation: Improves continuous integration build failure prediction using deep learning.

entries.title: Ravenbuild
entries.key_innovation: Predicts CI build outcomes for AAA video game changes, addressing data-impact and source-data boundary changes causing failures.

entries.title: Cost-effective build outcome prediction using cascaded classifiers
entries.key_innovation: Uses cascaded classifiers to predict build outcomes, emphasizing failed builds, reducing waiting time and server workload while identifying most defective builds.

entries.title: Buildfast
entries.key_innovation: Proposes BuildFast, a method for faster or cost-effective continuous integration builds.

entries.title: An empirical analysis of build failures in the continuous integration workflows of java based open-source software
entries.key_innovation: Empirically links commits to CI builds and categorizes build failures into common error types, revealing test failures and noisy build data as dominant causes.

entries.title: Using decision trees to predict the certification result of a build
entries.key_innovation: Uses decision trees to predict whether a build will pass certification based on historical build and test data.

entries.title: Reinforcement learning for test case prioritization
entries.key_innovation: Applies reinforcement learning to prioritize test cases for regression testing.

entries.title: Static test case prioritization using topic models
entries.key_innovation: Uses topic models to statically prioritize test cases.

entries.title: Techniques for improving regression testing in continuous integration development environments
entries.key_innovation: Proposes regression test selection algorithms for pre-submit continuous integration to reduce testing cost while maintaining fast feedback.

entries.title: How different is test case prioritization for open and closed source projects?
entries.key_innovation: Compares test case prioritization characteristics and effectiveness between open-source and closed-source projects.

entries.title: Empirically detecting false test alarms using association rules
entries.key_innovation: Uses association rule learning over failing test steps to identify patterns typical of false test alarms caused by test infrastructure issues.

entries.title: Modeling and ranking flaky tests at apple
entries.key_innovation: Models and ranks flaky tests to prioritize problematic tests at Apple.

entries.title: Practical Flaky Test Prediction using Common Code Evolution and Test History Data
entries.key_innovation: Predicts flaky tests using only test outcomes, durations, and basic code evolution data, avoiding instrumentation, reruns, or language-specific artifacts.

entries.title: Sentiment analysis of travis ci builds
entries.key_innovation: Analyzes the relationship between developer sentiment and continuous integration build outcomes in Travis CI.

entries.title: Waiting around or job half-done? sentiment in self-admitted technical debt
entries.key_innovation: Classifies self-admitted technical debt comments into a detailed taxonomy and analyzes their sentiment and external references.

entries.title: Cognitive biases in software engineering
entries.key_innovation: Systematically maps cognitive biases investigated in software engineering, synthesizing their antecedents, effects, and mitigation techniques.

entries.title: Regression Modeling Strategies
entries.key_innovation: Presents strategies for building and validating regression models in statistical analysis.

entries.title: Towards language-independent brown build detection
entries.key_innovation: Detects brown builds early by measuring textual similarity between current build logs and logs of prior brown builds.

entries.title: Degrees of Freedom in Statistical Inference
entries.key_innovation: Clarifies the role and interpretation of degrees of freedom in statistical inference.
